verdict.rationale: AMD's product page confirms PCIe 5.0 storage support and NVMe RAID configurations (Boot/RAID0/1/5/10), giving some concrete I/O specs a developer could plan around, but there's no documented PCIe lane count breakdown, chipset-dependent lane allocation, USB/Thunderbolt connectivity, or dock-compatible external I/O specs in the evidence pack. missing for 10: PCIe lane count/topology details, USB and external port/dock connectivity specs, chipset-specific I/O breakdown, independent verification of I/O headroom claims.
